message.text:
The scheduler package exists but is not wired into the server.

The nightly database-cleanup job is only documented in internal/scheduler/doc.go and example_test.go. No actual registration code exists for it. Other cron mechanisms are being checked.

The internal/scheduler package is only imported by its own tests and examples.

No nightly database-cleanup job exists in production. The server uses background runners with time.Ticker instead of the cron scheduler. The "0 2 * * *" schedule only appears in documentation and example code within internal/scheduler, not as a real registered job.
